text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 25px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #192f3e
font-size: 15px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #192f3e

g.text: We compared its score with an average of its predictions

text.style: font-size: 14px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #192f3e

g.text: after every legal move, weighted by how likely each move was.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 17px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #192f3e

g.text: Cases with a gap bigger than 10 percentage points

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 20px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #192f3e
font-weight: 700; font-size: 26px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #c65b4b
font-weight: 700; font-size: 20px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #192f3e
font-weight: 700; font-size: 26px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #c65b4b
font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #55636b

g.text: Each dot is one position. Red means a large disagreement.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 18px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #192f3e

g.text: Typical gap: about 4 points at both ratings.

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #55636b

g.text: The same 100 positions were used at both ratings, with history on.

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #55636b

g.text: A disagreement does not tell us which estimate is closer to the truth.

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #55636b

g.text: This sample does not establish that one rating is more reliable.
